settings.reconstruction: scipy stft/istft; zero extension and padded; output trimmed to original sample count
settings.PCM: signed PCM16; round halves away from zero
settings.metric_reference: paired original Clean reference; same reference for BPF-only and both SS branches
settings.metric_interval: full common overlap after shared BPF-derived cross-correlation delay (search +/-0.5 s); not separate alignment optimization for SS candidates
